sources.title: AgentAbstain: Do LLM Agents Know When Not to Act?
sources.supports: A commit-boundary, trace-observable construct for agentic abstention.
sources.does_not_establish: Any multilingual effect, a language-conditioned authorization failure, or deployment prevalence.

inspection_spans.observation: Agentic abstention is framed as a sequential act-or-abstain decision before a potentially irreversible commit; the benchmark has 263 paired tasks and 42 executable sandboxes.

inspection_spans.observation: The taxonomy distinguishes successful or implicit abstention, no abstention, and post-hoc abstention after an irreversible action.
